title: hosts.toml
description: The share hosts the index trusts to say who owns an upload, per RFC 0094, one table per host. The rules the schema cannot say are tools/check_hosts.py.

hostKey.$comment: The key a listing names the host with under [releases]. It is HOST_KEY of tools/authored.py in content-index-releases, and it is not a key that [releases] already has. authored.schema.json has the same pattern twice, and tools/test_check_hosts.py keeps the copies equal.
hostKey.title: a host key of 2 to 32 lowercase ASCII letters, digits or '-', starting with a letter, and not github, spacedock, authority or since

baseUrl.title: an https URL that ends with /, without a query or a fragment

ed25519Key.title: an Ed25519 public key as standard base64 of its SubjectPublicKeyInfo, which starts with MCowBQYDK2VwAyEA and ends with =

kind.description: share, the only kind RFC 0094 defines.

name.description: The name a client shows for the host.

storage.description: The GitHub repository that holds the archives and the data files of the host, as owner/repo.

not.title: a repository of the KSAModding organization, which never hosts files (RFC 0025)

data.description: The base URL that serves the data files and their .sig signatures, for a host that keeps its archives outside GitHub instead of in storage.

downloads.description: The URL prefixes that the archives of a host with data are served under. A url of a release list entry, and every redirect of it, stays under one of them.

key.description: The Ed25519 public key that signs the data files of a host with data.

retired_keys.description: Earlier values of key. They only check signatures that an ownership record on a pull request already holds, and never a data file that is read now.

bot.description: The numeric id of the GitHub account the host opens pull requests as.

api.description: The base URL of the upload API.

pages.description: The GitHub Pages address of storage, which a reader asks before raw.githubusercontent.com.

types.description: The content types the host takes. A listing of another type may not name it.

max_bytes.description: The largest archive the host takes, per type. The watcher and the listing checks refuse a larger one too.

new_listings_per_day.description: How many new ids one account of the host may claim per day. The host enforces it.

policy.description: The policy of the host for takedowns, abuse reports and the privacy of its accounts, which POLICY.md links.
policy.title: an https URL
